_note: Where a borrowed piece sits on a character's portrait head.
The hat was lifted out of the full captain (tools/extract_shells.py), and that
model's head is a different Tripo run at a different size from the portrait head,
so the piece has to be scaled and hung off the crown rather than the origin.
scale and offset put the hat's base at 72% of the portrait head's height, just above the ears, and match its opening to the skull there.
offset is in the portrait head's own space, Y-up, metres.
Nudge these by eye - they are a placement, not a measurement to defend.
in_frame false keeps a piece out of the portrait framing. The captain's plume is a foot of feather; counting it would shrink his face to fit it in.
